senses.gloss: sprout. Esp. Lulab, the branch of the palm-tree used for the festive wreath on the Feast of Booths (Lev. XXIII, 40); also the festive wreath of the four species combined.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sukkah 3:1">Succ. III, 1</cite> <he>ל׳ הגזול וכ׳</he> a palm-branch unlawfully acquired or one dried up.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sukkah 3:4">Ib. 4</cite> <he>ל׳ אחד</he> one branch of the palm-tree is needed for the festive wreath.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sukkah 3:9">Ib. 9</cite> <he>מי … ולא היה בידיו ל׳ ליטול</he> a traveller on the road who had no opportunity of performing the ceremony of taking the festive wreath in hand.

<cite ref="Mishnah Sukkah 3:9">Ib.</cite> <he>כל היום כשר לל׳</he> the entire day is fit (no special time of the day is designated) for the ceremony &c. Ib. 12; <cite ref="Mishnah Rosh Hashanah 4:3">R. Hash. IV, 3</cite> <cite ref="E00230"><he>היה</he></cite> (<cite ref="E00000"><he>ה</he></cite>)<he>ל׳ … במקדש וכ׳</he> the ceremony of Lulab was performed in the Temple seven days &c.; <cite ref="Sukkah 46a:7">Succ. 46ᵃ</cite> <he>יום ראשון מצות ל׳ וכ׳</he> on the first day it is the Biblical law of Lulab which is carried out, on the following days it is the carrying out of an ordinance of the elders; a. fr.—Pl. <he>לוּלָבִים</he>, <he>לוּלָבִין</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Orlah 1:7">Orl. I, 7</cite>. <he>העלים והל׳</he> leaves and eatable young sprouts.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 7:5">Shebi. VII, 5</cite>, a. e. <he>לוּלָבֵי זרדים</he>, v. <cite ref="G00669"><he>זֶרֶד</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 55a">Ber. 55ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>ל׳ גפנים</he> sprouts of grape-vine; <cite ref="Yoma 81b:9">Yoma 81ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="L00084"><he>לִבְלֵב</he></cite>.—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 41:1">Gen. R. s. 41</cite>, beg. <he>לוּלָבֶיהָ להלל</he> its branches are used for praise (v. <cite ref="E00573"><he>הַלֵּל</he></cite>); <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 3:1">Num. R. s. 3</cite>, beg., v. <cite ref="E00394"><he>הִילּוּל</he></cite>; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 92:8">Midr. Till. to Ps. XCII, 13</cite> (sing.).
<cite ref="Mishnah Sukkah 4:4">Succ. IV, 4</cite> <he>מוליכין את לוּלָבֵיהֶן וכ׳</he> they used to bring their festive wreaths to the Temple mount &c.; a. fr.

senses.gloss: לוּלָבִין twigs used as brooms in the wine press (Rashi), cmp. אַלְבִּינָא; the two posts supporting the beams of the press (Ar.).
units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 75a">Ab. Zar. 75ᵃ</cite>; Y. ib. V, end, 45ᵇ; <cite ref="Niddah 65a">Nidd. 65ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Tahorot 11:16">Tosef. Toh. XI, 16</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 8:3">Tosef. Ab. Zar. VIII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 9:3">IX</cite>), 3.
